name: DLSS 4 DLAA
author: Echo-Storm
description: Runs NVIDIA DLSS anti-aliasing (DLAA) on Lossless Scaling's frames on the LSFG GPU and applies the result to every presented frame, real and generated, without ever making Lossless Scaling wait: smoother, steadier edges without changing the look. NVIDIA's DLSS runtime is included. Only one of this and DLSS 5 Neural Rendering works at a time.
